Direction.description: The base direction of a line.

Element.description: A positioned element other than text, by its bounding box.

x0_blu.description: `x0` in BLU, where the engine produced it.

x1_blu.description: `x1` in BLU, where the engine produced it.

y0_blu.description: `y0` in BLU, where the engine produced it.

y1_blu.description: `y1` in BLU, where the engine produced it.

ElementKind.description: A kind of positioned element other than text.

oneOf.description: An image, by the box it fills.
A straight line or a thin filled rectangle, horizontal or vertical: borders, underlines, separators.
The box of a table cell.

family.description: The font family, where the producer knows it: the PDF's `FontFamily`, or the engine's family name. Absent otherwise.

name.description: The font's name as the producer knows it: in a PDF the `BaseFont` without the six-letter subset tag (`Calibri-Bold`, `TimesNewRomanPSMT`), which is the font's PostScript name for TrueType and OpenType fonts; for the engine, the PostScript name of the font file.

Glyph.description: A glyph placed on a line.

advance.description: How far the glyph moves the pen along its baseline: its advance width at its size, with the producer's character and word spacing, without kerning or other positioning that moves the next glyph only.

advance_blu.description: `advance` in BLU, where the engine produced it.

font.description: The index of its font in `fonts`.

gid.description: The glyph identifier in the font, where the producer knows it.

length.description: How many characters of the line's `text` the glyph shows: more than one for a ligature, zero for a glyph that shows no character of the text. Glyphs of one cluster share the same characters; other glyphs never share any.

offset.description: The index, in the line's `text`, of the first character that the glyph shows, counted in characters (Unicode scalar values).

size.description: The font size: the height of the em square, perpendicular to the baseline.

size_blu.description: `size` in BLU, where the engine produced it.

x.description: The x of the glyph's origin.

x_blu.description: `x` in BLU, where the engine produced it.

y.description: The y of the glyph's origin, on its baseline (above the line's baseline for a superscript).

y_blu.description: `y` in BLU, where the engine produced it.

Line.description: A line: text on one baseline.

baseline.description: The y of the line's baseline, where the producer knows it.

baseline_blu.description: The baseline in BLU, where the engine produced it.

direction.description: The line's base direction, where the producer knows it.

end.description: The offset after its last character, where the producer knows it.

glyphs.description: The line's glyphs in display order, from left to right, where the producer knows them. Requires `text`.

start.description: The offset of the line's first character, where the producer knows it (see `text_offsets`).

text.description: The line's characters in logical (reading) order, by the text rules of `lab/schema/layout-json.md`, where the producer knows them.

LineCoverage.description: Whether the pages list every line.

oneOf.description: Only some lines (Word's object model samples paragraphs).

elements.description: The page's images, rules and table cells, where the producer reports them, in drawing order; absent when it does not.

height.description: The height of the page as displayed.

height_blu.description: The height in BLU, where the engine produced it.

lines.description: The lines of the page in reading order (see `lab/schema/layout-json.md`).

skipped_glyphs.description: The PDF extractor's count of glyphs that it drew on no line: text that is not upright, and invisible text (render modes 3 and 7). Absent for other producers.

start.description: The offset of the page's first character, where the producer knows it.

width.description: The width of the page as displayed (in a PDF, the crop box turned by the page's rotation).

width_blu.description: The width in BLU, where the engine produced it.

Points.description: A length or coordinate in points, with at most three decimals (a fixed precision of a thousandth of a point).

SchemaVersion.description: The version of the layout JSON.

Source.description: Who produced a layout JSON, which tells what its fields can hold.

oneOf.description: bayan-lab's PDF extractor, from a PDF (in the lab, the PDF that Word exported): glyphs, lines, images and rules, with offsets into its own text (`text_offsets` is `lines`).
Word's object model, through the ground-truth harness of LAB-002: page sizes and the document positions where pages and sampled lines start; no glyphs.
BayanDocs' engine, through `bayan-cli`: everything, with lengths also in BLU.

TextOffsets.description: What the `start` and `end` offsets of pages and lines count.

oneOf.description: Characters (Unicode scalar values) of the file's own text stream: the `text` of every line, page after page and line after line, each followed by one line feed (U+000A). Every line then has `start`, `end` and `text`, and `end - start` is the number of characters of its `text`.

Positions in the source document's text, as its producer counts them (Word's character positions, or the engine's). They increase through the document but need not match the lines' `text`, which holds what is displayed.

description: A layout JSON file: the layout of one document.

fonts.description: The fonts that glyphs refer to by their index in this list.

line_coverage.description: Whether the pages list every line.

page_count.description: The number of pages; equal to the length of `pages`.

producer.description: The program and its version, such as `bayan-lab pdf-extract 1`: printable text of at most 256 characters.

text_offsets.description: What the offsets of pages and lines count.
